nativeStructure.profile: one real row field followed by Values, multiple measures, optional real column axis
nativeStructure.compact: one label column; blank outer heading, indented measure rows and one total row per measure
nativeStructure.outline: Category/Values columns; blank outer heading before measure rows, optional repeated Category labels
nativeStructure.rowItems: outer heading then compressed prefix r=1 for each measure; i indexes measures
nativeStructure.headers: one row without columns, two with columns; compact uses Row Labels and Column Labels
nativeStructure.indent: root indent=0, cell indent=1 for compact measure labels, zero elsewhere
nativeStructure.subtotals: automatic outer subtotals and their position do not add rows across the Values pseudo field

coverage: every cached/refreshed value, type, row/column dimension and label indentation
sum/count/average/min/max, repeated source measures, custom measure captions, source errors and sparse column groups
two/three measures with optional real column field and repeat-label preferences
five native imports, explicit refresh after source edit and save/reopen
all six conversions between tabular, compact and outline with Values remaining last on rows
limits: two real row fields plus Values on rows remains unsupported
Values first, custom indentation, custom Values headers, grouping, slicers and shared caches remain preserved without refresh
